name: Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners 2 Update
summary:
This update expands the open-world action RPG with new side quests, including a story set before Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, plus new gear, cyberware customization, and dual-wielding abilities. Players can also discover additional Tarot cards and use new poses in Photo Mode.

Behind the scenes, the update brings cross-platform mod support, quality-of-life enhancements for saves and item storage, performance and graphics upgrades, new character customization options, and targeted fixes for quests and gameplay issues.
